change.before: "changing device MTU requires restarting the agent to pick up the new MTU"
change.after: "MTU auto-detection is continuous during agent lifetime"

consequence.statement: The running agent now picks up device MTU changes automatically, without an agent restart, instead of keeping the MTU it detected at startup.
consequence.remediation: Check that environments which change device MTU at runtime expect the agent to apply the new MTU without a restart.

assertion.statement: In Cilium 1.17.0, the agent keeps detecting the MTU while it runs, so it picks up a changed device MTU without needing a restart.

proposal.undeterminedReason: applicability: The evidence names no setting that turns MTU auto-detection on or off, so no configuration predicate can be written without inventing a key.
